QuestInfo.name: [Miwok Rescue] Brave Ribbon Pig Energy
QuestInfo.0: Polite Greeting wanted to talk to you after your last trip to #bSnakerot Jungle#k.
QuestInfo.1: You will receive the #i1142547##r#t1142547:# Medal#k and the#i3010516##r#t3010516:# Chair#k if you complete the missions in the #bMiwok Rescue Log#k.
QuestInfo.2: You received the #i1142547##r#t1142547:# Medal#k and #i3010516##r#t3010516:# Chair#k for completing the #bMiwok Rescue Log#k. Go on, give it a sit!

0.0: The best of days to you kind stranger, my name is #bPolite Greeting#k. Might I bother you for a moment?

yes.0: It sure is nice to see you. It makes me want to tell you of my tribe's oldest legend. There was once a pig, the #bBravest Ribbon Pig#k. She wanted nothing more than to be human, so she did what any sane human would do... she consumed only mugwort and garlic for 3 months and 10 days in a cave. Eventually, she turned into the #bbeautiful founding chieftess#k of our tribe.
yes.1: You're looking so well today. Almost as well as the only medal ever found befitting of such a chieftess: the #i1142547##r#t1142547:##k. Would you like to see it?
yes.2: Hel-looo! I can't just give it to you. You have to prove you're as worthy as our pig-goddess-tribal-founder. Maybe if you complete #rall six missions#k in the #bMiwok Rescue Log#k...
yes.3: Why don't we talk more often? I almost forgot to tell you about the #i3010516##r#t3010516:# Chair#k my friends made! I just know you'll love the amazing dance routine that comes along with it.

no.0: Hello? Are you sure? You will surely regret not listening.

1.0: Hi there! Did you get through all of the #bMiwok Rescue Log#k missions?

yes.0: My, don't you look--you did it?! You got through all the #bMiwok Rescue Log#k missions? Oh geez. I, uh, let me just clean this piece of junk off...
yes.1:
Oh, hi! I mean, it's totally the most revered item we have and I did not buy it off a very well-spoken orangutan last time I was at a swap meet. Here, you were so amazing and pig-like that you should have this #i1142547##r#t1142547:##k. 

Just take this and the #i3010516##r#t3010516:# Chair#k, and don't tell anybody okay?

default.0: Aw, how's your family doing? I ask, because I can't give you the reward and I don't want them to be too sad. So just #rall six missions#k in the #bMiwok Rescue Log#k and they'll feel better! Oh, and make sure your Equip and Set-up tabs have room.
